name: Startup preparatory visa (創業活動)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires endorsement from a participating local government (originally under National Strategic Special Zones) or the newer national-level startup support program, confirming a genuine business plan intended to reach the Business Manager visa's capital threshold.
requirements.fix_path: Apply to a participating local government or national startup support program for endorsement.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a genuine business plan with a credible path to meeting the Business Manager visa's capital and structural requirements within the preparatory period.

evidence_required.document: Endorsement letter from a participating local government or national program

outcome.duration_length: 6 months to 1 year (varies by municipality/program), not directly renewable beyond the preparatory period

sources.title: Immigration Services Agency of Japan — 創業活動 (startup preparatory activity) visa framework

notes: SOURCING CAVEAT flagged honestly: the exact current 2026 status of any unification of the historically fragmented, municipality-by-municipality National Strategic Special Zone startup visa system into a single national program was not fully confirmed at tier-1 precision during this research pass — treat the endorsement pathway as potentially varying by specific local government until this is verified. Deliberately terminal in this dataset (leads_to_pr: false, not itself renewable) — its entire function is bridging an entrepreneur to jp_business_manager, which now requires ¥30,000,000 in capital following the October 2025 reform (see that route's notes) — meaning this preparatory visa has become significantly MORE valuable as a bridge than before, since the target threshold it's preparing founders to reach is six times higher than it used to be, a real second-order effect of the Business Manager reform worth surfacing.
